title: Consistent connector API
body:
In order to reduce the API surface and ease connector usage, the props they forward should always be the same.
- [x] the only way to set a default refinement is via defaultRefinement
- [ ] the items format is always {name, value[, isRefined, count]}
- [ ] remove refine() (from lists), currentRefinement
- [ ] add toggleRefinement(), clear()
- [ ] double check and investigate possible differences lists (RefinementList) and single elements (toggle)

Linked issues: #1305 #1423
